people.name: Kiryu
text:
Or I was, till they pinned a
killing in that empty lot on me.

I'll find who set me up.
Whatever it takes.

people.name: Majima
text:
Majima: Heeey! You look like ya
can handle yerself!

Name's Goro Majima.
The Mad Dog of Shimano!

people.name: Tout
text:
Maharaja's the hottest disco in
Kamurocho!

The dance floor never sleeps.
Neither does this town.

people.name: Hostess
text: Pink Street's lit up all night.

Every club round here wants a
regular. Will you be ours?

people.name: Drinker
text:
Champion District... a maze of
bars no bigger than a closet.

Get lost in there and you might
not want to find your way out.

people.name: Lookout
text: Keep away from that empty lot.

A man was shot there, and every
family in the Tojo Clan wants
the land under it.

people.name: Thug
text:
...Hmph. Smile Burger's got the
best burgers in town. Don't tell
anyone I said that.

people.name: Salaryman
text:
Taihei Boulevard's that way.
The last train's long gone.

Guess it's another night in
Kamurocho...

people.name: Bowler
text:
Mach Bowl's right here.
Strikes all night!
